checks.name: one device, many types; direct sales and MAT stay independent; confirmed/pending/excluded/off-sale separated
one accessory many models; real object and model counts distinct from relation counts
missing model and brand-only/name-only records never guess; manual/template explicit bindings and changed source detected
template identity uses stable bound param IDs, not brand or names; common/variant conflicts are invalid
historical cross-product-type bindings and duplicate explicit bindings stay invalid
model/plan/historical SKU use pinned snapshot and actual generation source; plan SKU need not have sku.planningId
one read context reuses a frozen version expansion across multiple device resolutions and releases with caller
later ProductPlan node/version edits do not rewrite historical SKU device identity or exact PLN
same model colors/capacities share model declarations; Pro/Pro Max and other PLN remain isolated
same-named models in distinct model namespaces do not merge; ambiguous snapshot not silently first
confirmed explicit deny wins across model/PLN scope; pending deny never becomes confirmed recommendation
conditional exclusions respect actual attributes: met denies, unmet does not, unknown remains pending
conditions use actual attributes; unknown equipment/protocol/power never count as satisfied; basic/fast-charge independent
reverse PLN-specific opposite results are not collapsed into unconditional model fact
no-basic multiple specific abilities aggregate conservatively and never depend on declaration array order
unique confirmed model works without PLN; standalone candidates require no MAT/SKU/active planning
legacy MAT defaults retain identity and history; invalid target/type/condition/source stay issues, not recommendations
loaded target aliases that disagree or omit target kind are preserved as issues, never reinterpreted as another valid object
query and reverse are fully read-only; no node rule becomes a formal statement; search/type filters count actual objects
